full_judgment: 12. Next I come to the question of custody of the title deed after the sale. It is an admitted case of both the parties that the original kabala was burnt in a fire that broke out in the house of Abul Meah at a time when both Abul Meah and Mouna Khatun were living to gather under the same roof as husband and wife. Not only that Abul Meah could not produce that original deed but Mouna Khatun or persons claiming through her could not also produce the same. In the instant case, therefore, the failure of the plaintiff to produce the original kabala from his custody has been explained and no ad verse presumption against the plaintiff is warranted.
